datasets.name: Open-source landslide dataset (Bijie)
datasets.verbatim: In this study, the proposed adversarial nets were trained using the open-source dataset [21], which can be downloaded at http://gpcv.whu.edu.cn/data/Bijie_pages.html (accessed on 10 May 2022).

methods.name: End-to-end, semi-supervised adversarial network
methods.summary: An adversarial network framework for landslide extraction consisting of a generator (based on pix2pix) to learn semantic features via semi-supervised operation and a discriminator (improved DeepLabv3+) with multilevel skip connections and a topographic CNN to fuse spectral and topographic features.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and linked, but the custom code for the adversarial network is not provided or linked. The UAV-photogrammetry-derived data is not mentioned or accessible.
